title: Burnout: light kick, guarded OD Wave and counter-hit jab
summary: Keep Jamie guarding light kick and OD Wave, then confirm the counter-hit crouching jab into the medium route.
conditions: Jamie is already in Burnout with three drinks, cornered at the recorded spacing. The opening normal is guarded; only the later counter-hit portion is a combo.
notes: Dated training recording; the route and matchup timings have not been retested on the current game patch.
This is the specific recorded Burnout pressure interaction, not a universal true-blockstring or reversal-proof guarantee. No numerical gap is inferred from the chapter title.
